value.signature: fn body_from_projection (value : & Value) -> Result < ProposalBody , ProfileError >

review.body: { if value . canonical_len () > BODY_LIMIT { return Err (ProfileError :: Bound) ; } let body = parse_body (value) ? ; validate_body (& body) ? ; if structural_value (& body) != * value { return Err (ProfileError :: BodyShape) ; } Ok (body) }
review.item_premise: The supplied B3 projection is public; checked structure returns a typed body without authenticating its author.
